title: Sets and frozen dictionary keys
description: You can observe unique membership and order-independent lookup.

steps.description: You add a twice but keep one copy in seen. sorted displays ['a', 'b'], and the membership checks print True False.
Union, written |, keeps items from either set and prints ['a', 'b', 'c']. Intersection, written &, keeps their shared item and prints ['b'].

steps.question: Will the frozenset made from b and a find the key made from seen?
steps.answer: Yes. Both contain the same two items, so they compare equal regardless of the order used to build them.

steps.description: You use an immutable frozenset as a dictionary key. The lookup prints a set as a dictionary key.
